metadata.description: Vendor-neutral, multi-project Claude Code agent framework. One shared core plus opt-in domain packs; per-project flavor comes from each consumer's project.json overlay.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Vendor-neutral agent-development core: generic agents, skills, commands, hooks, and the project-aware agent-work CLI.

plugins.name: uav-pack
plugins.description: UAV/drone domain pack: MAVLink-style telemetry, mission planning, embedded/edge runtime.

plugins.name: iot-pack
plugins.description: IoT domain pack: BLE communication, device telemetry, health-metrics processing.

plugins.name: web-pack
plugins.description: Web/marketing domain pack: SEO, i18n, landing-page CRO, Figma-to-code styling.

plugins.name: infra-pack
plugins.description: Infrastructure & delivery domain pack: Kubernetes/Helm, GitOps promotion, IaC, GitLab CI, cloud CI auth (GCP + AWS), Keycloak. Opt-in; requires core.

plugins.name: lsp-pack
plugins.description: Semantic code-navigation pack: Serena LSP MCP server. Opt-in; requires the serena binary (uv) on the machine.

plugins.name: claude-eng-pack
plugins.description: Claude-engineering pack: skills for building/auditing Claude agent systems — agent architecture, tool/MCP design, prompt engineering, Claude Code config, context reliability. Opt-in; requires core.

plugins.name: graphify-pack
plugins.description: Knowledge-graph pack: the /graphify skill — repo/folder → persistent knowledge graph with query/path/affected tools and HTML/JSON/Neo4j exports. Opt-in; requires the graphify CLI on the machine.

plugins.name: architecture-pack
plugins.description: Repo-wide architecture map: /architecture-map generates a machine-readable JSON contract (layers, modules, file-anchored flows) + self-contained HTML viewer, freshness-stamped per commit; the swarmery dashboard serves both on its Architecture page.

plugins.name: jira-pack
plugins.description: Issue-tracker pack: /jira-fix drives any Jira ticket end-to-end — access preflight, defect-or-change triage, reproduction or test-first evidence, delegated fix/implementation, evidence comment, QA transition. Opt-in; requires core and an Atlassian MCP provider enabled on the machine.

plugins.name: accounts-pack
plugins.description: Multi-account pack: bind a project to one of several Claude Code accounts and run every session under it — /account, a shell wrapper, an optional shell function, and a wrong-account warning. Opt-in; requires the swarmery CLI.

plugins.name: design-pack
plugins.description: Design-handoff pack: /design-implement takes an exported design and re-expresses it in the project's stack pixel-accurately — computed-style token inventory, reuse-vs-create recon, an approval gate, and a measured pixel diff as the completion criterion. Opt-in; requires core.
